items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
GOAL: Keep Oxygen Not Included colony (Cycle 1, 3 dupes: Bubbles, Gossmann, Ashkan) alive by getting breathable O2; needs Oxygen Diffuser, which requires building 200 kg Metal Ore. Alert 'No Oxygen Generator built' active. Oxygen ~0-2%, duplicants inhale 0/-100 g/s; they survive in a small breathable pocket at the Printing Pod platform. Also alerted: no Outhouse. Food OK (~12,524 kcal).

CONFIRMED OBSERVATIONS:
- Copper Ore exists in the ceiling rock band (326 kg tile found at ~(0.42,0.135), also ~(0.60,0.085) in other zooms). Oxylite tiles (~143-200 kg) sit in/near that ceiling band (e.g. ~(0.545,0.13)); excavating oxylite releases O2.
- Green tiles = Algae (needed by diffuser too); dark speckled = Sandstone/Dirt/Coal; dark blue-mottled unexplored patches may be Wolframite.
- The map is bounded; colony sits on a platform with open pod chamber above; water pools to the west.

CONTROLS LEARNED:
- UI clicks often need hover one frame, then click-in-place next frame; move+click often only registers as hover.
- G selects Dig, Escape cancels tool/Esc closes most panels (double Escape opens PAUSED menu which blocks clicks). Space toggles pause but often ends up paused; explicit play button more reliable.
- Speed/alert icons top-left vary by zoom; observed rows at y approx 0.031-0.083 with pause ~0.086-0.113, play ~0.097-0.128, fast/fastest to the right (~0.12-0.14); 'Unlock blueprints' icon ~0.19; red alert toggle ~0.168 at one zoom (confirmed via tooltip). Red Alert is currently ON (forces work ignoring needs).
- Sim effectively pauses between actions (~1 s game time per step); progress requires repeated unpause+wait. Multi-second waits only advance if sim left running.
- Base menu (bottom-left ~(0.031-0.047,0.918-0.94)): Ladder=Sandstone 100 kg, plus Tile, Pneumatic Door, Storage Bin. Must click Ladder tile (hover then click) opening material card, then drag/click in empty air cells. Drags succeed even with material card open; multi-tile drags overlapping built cells or deck row give 'Must be built in unoccupied space'.
- Speed buttons earlier at ~(0.143,0.079) worked; pause/play positions drift with camera zoom - always re-locate from current screenshot.
- Info panels open when no tool active; panel X sometimes needs hover-then-click; X positions drift.
- Dig designation toggles: second click on same tile cancels. Red X = unreachable/cancelled. 'Unreachable Build' tooltip = blueprint not adjacent to standing cell. Reach is ~1 tile.
- Cancel tool at ~(0.69-0.71,0.915-0.94) removes blueprints instantly (red X left behind).
- Deconstruct via Ration Box panel button; box was removed successfully freeing space under ladder.
- Checking Resources panel showed only Sandstone (300-940 kg at times); no metal ore ever stored.
- Blueprint overlay legend (Oxygen/Power) can be toggled off by clicking the highlighted overlay icon in the OVERLAYS row (Power icon at ~(0.799,0.104) worked after hover).
- Ladder builds DO progress when sim runs: observed 'Awaiting Delivery' -> 'Under Construction' -> built 'Normal' segments over repeated waits; many segments built but always left a gap.

REPEATED FAILED STRATEGY (unresolved):
- Every ladder column (at various times x approx 0.355, 0.46, 0.49, 0.555, 0.594, 0.62, 0.72) ends 1-4 tiles above the walkable platform or has upper sections 'Unreachable Build / Awaiting Delivery' that dupes never build, even with duplicants standing directly below and Red Alert on. Attempts to fill gaps failed either with 'Must be built in unoccupied space' (cell already built/blueprint) or the new blueprints also become unreachable. Cause uncertain: possibly part of columns overlap the Printing Pod footprint (iron ore, x approx 0.68-0.75) or gaps contain solid rock not air.
- Ceiling dig designations near copper ore keep showing 'Unreachable Dig' (red X) because no continuous climbable ladder reaches the ceiling; digs at (0.42,0.135) etc stayed unreachable.
- Building a ladder from Bubbles' ledge (~0.50,0.44) upward placed many segments (sandstone dropped 670->370->170 kg) yet upper scaffold still flagged unreachable.
- Note: sandstone supply is nearly exhausted (~170 kg); earlier a 920 kg sandstone tile was successfully mined at deck's right end, and 590 kg hauling observed once.

CURRENT SITUATION (last frames): Dig tool active; left ladder column x approx 0.355-0.44 built from Bubbles' ledge to ceiling band; oxylite/copper ore present beside ladder top in ceiling band; last action designated a dig at (0.40,0.15) on the dark block near the left ladder top (result unknown). Red Alert on, sim likely paused; need to unpause (play button) and wait to see if that dig is reachable and if it yields oxylite (O2) or metal ore.

NEXT IDEAS UNTRIED/VALIDATED:
- Dig oxylite adjacent to built ladder tops for O2 relief.
- Place ONE ladder blueprint directly above a duplicant's head (must be empty air, not platform row, not pod footprint) and build upward incrementally.
- Mine more sandstone/supplies; find reachable copper ore elsewhere (e.g., right-side cave beyond backwall digs at x approx 0.84-0.9 were unreachable).
- Confirm pause/play state each step; keep sim running with fastest speed for construction progress.
